inspection.scope: Full classification assumptions/tables, explicit single-zeta and single-W examples, generic scalar/fermion-copy boundary.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

Gauge symmetry required only GSM, full RSM included, new fermions vector-like/Majorana. Extra Proca vectors need not be gauge connections of a larger group. Source treats these as EFTs below cutoff, not necessarily complete renormalizable UV theories. Generic tables allow arbitrary copies, not all mediators simultaneously.

locator.section_equations: Table1, Section5 scalar-zeta example Eqs.(5.5)-(5.7), AppendixA.7

claims.value: Explicit single-zeta example adds one complex scalar (3,3,-1/3), colour Dynkin[1,0],weak[2], to RSM. Its ql and qq couplings are interactions of the same multiplet; do not duplicate it or turn QQ contraction into an extra field.

locator.section_equations: Table3, Section5 Vector iso-triplet W Eqs.(5.11)-(5.14); A.17

claims.value: Displayed single-triplet matching example uses a real massive W=(1,3,0), canonically real prefactor1/2 in Proca kinetic/mass terms. Its charged/neutral components form one real weak triplet, not three copies. Possible extra L1 expressly excluded in this example; no new internal gauge factor is imposed.

Generic singlet scalar and Majorana-N matching sectors permit arbitrary number of fields. N is one Majorana species per chosen copy, not Dirac by default; no fixed universal multiplicity inferred from table heading. Scalar S interactions with gluons are EFT operators, not evidence for its UV coloured mediators.
